title: Bill Nygren - Fundamental Investing From A Generalist's Perspective

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: With the constant evolution of the asset management industry.
reader_summary.overview: With the constant evolution of the asset management industry, investors need to stay a step ahead to justify earning an active management fee. With over 40 years of experience in the industry, this is a lesson that today's guest, Bill Nygren of Harris Associates. Bill is a true legend of value investing and an investor you can turn to whenever the market is uncertain.

key_points.text: With over 40 years of experience in the industry, this is a lesson that today's guest, Bill Nygren of Harris Associates.
He radiates fundamental ideas and has an expansive perspective on the comings and goings of the market and the economy at large.
Bill is the Chief Investment Officer for US equities at Harris Associates, which he joined in 1983.
